tweets.author: tradingstrategies.work
tweets.text:
6/8

Strategy is not forced to sell bitcoin. Saylor says no covenants or triggers are tied to the price.

Its buying hangs on one test: new shares only add bitcoin per share above 1x net asset value.

Last week it bought 250 BTC. In Q1 it was about 89,600.

tweets.author: tradingstrategies.work
tweets.text:
5/8

The bigger loss is ten months old. Since January, MSCI has frozen Strategy's share count in its indexes.

From late June to early October Strategy sold 50.4m new shares to fund bitcoin. Not one became index weight.

Removal ends a flow that had already stopped.

tweets.author: tradingstrategies.work
tweets.text:
4/8

The $2.8bn figure comes from JPMorgan in November 2025, calculated on MSCI's earlier proposal and a higher share price.

On Friday MSTR fell 9.6%, on a day the Nasdaq lost 2.1% and bitcoin 0.8%. The index news was priced within one session, not on 30 November.
